    • Method Detail

      • getFlags

        byte getFlags()
        This method returns the flags for the CID data which should be interpreted as a bit map. The flags represent which fields are present for the CID data. If the flag indicates that a field is not present, the user should clear that field. The bit values are:
        • 0x01 - CID Current. If set, CIDData values should be used. Note that Security Qualifiers may be present when this flag is not set.
        • 0x02 - Security Qualifiers
        Returns:
        flags as a byte which should be interpreted as a bit map.

      • getSecurityQualifiers

        short[] getSecurityQualifiers()
        This method returns the security qualifiers for the CID data. This is a short[] type object that should be cross referenced with Qualifier meta data on customer portal.
        Returns:
        short[] of security qualifiers.

      • getExchangeTime

        @Deprecated
int getExchangeTime()
        Deprecated. a Java primitive int is unable to represent times after 03:14:07 UTC on 19 January 2038. Use getExchangeTimeAsInstant() or getExchangeTimeSeconds() instead. getExchangeTimeNanoseconds() can be used to get the nanoseconds portion of the exchange time.
        This method returns the exchange time for the CID data in seconds precision. The exchange time is sent from the exchange. If a particular exchange does not send the time, it will be the time the feed received the CID data. The value is the number of seconds since epoch.
        Returns:
        exchange time in seconds precision as an integer.

        This method returns the exchange time for the CID data with nanosecond precision. The exchange time is sent from the exchange. If a particular exchange does not send the time, it will be the time the feed received the CID data.
        Returns:
        exchange time with nanosecond precision as an Instant

      • getSeries
